title: Shortest 2-design curve conjecture for the 2-sphere
statement:
Let $\gamma$ be the curve derived in the paper's Subsection~, considered up to isometry and reparameterization. A **2-design curve** is a curve satisfying the spherical $2$-design condition.

**Shortest 2-design curve conjecture.** The curve $\gamma$ is the shortest $2$-design curve in $S^2$, up to isometry and reparameterization.
The conjecture is motivated by the preceding construction; its validity and the classification of all equality cases remain open.
source_name: Emily J. King and Dustin G. Mixon, “Short spherical t-design curves”, arXiv:2607.15386 (2026).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.15386

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of July 2026).
